decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block references and updates the About-page prize copy to the continuing $900 Small Block prizes.
The generic rule that active prize tickets follow the NFT remains valid for the remaining Small Block tickets; the source does not establish new transfer behavior.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the required Base network deployment.
The source changes the $30 purchase allocation and removes Big Blocks but does not change the $48 secondary-sale royalty requirement.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket lifecycle and narrows the contexts to the remaining Small Block lifecycle.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block prizes and tickets from the FAQ and updates the purchase allocation and continuing-prize copy.
The NFT token serial remains the permanent referral code and its display locations are unaffected by removal of the Big Block prize mechanism.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $8 purchase allocation to the remaining prize pool; the continuing $900 Small Block rules otherwise remain unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket issuance key while retaining Small Block ticket issuance.
The $10 no-referral commission and its random existing-ticket-holder recipient rule remain valid; the source does not establish a different commission recipient.
The generic one-ticket allocation for a mint without a referral code remains applicable to the continuing Small Block system, and no Big-Block-specific key exists to remove.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, wallet provisioning, supported payment methods, or the requirement's deferred lifecycle status.
